title: Climate Time Machine: 1950 – 2100
description: Yearly maximum of monthly maximum temperature over land, 1950-2100, from NASA's NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 dataset: downscaled results of the CMIP6 global climate models used in the IPCC Sixth Assessment Report. Years up to 2014 are the models' historical runs; later years follow one of four emissions scenarios (SSPs). These are scenario-based model projections, not forecasts.

scenarios.label: Low emissions
scenarios.blurb: The world cuts greenhouse gas emissions quickly and reaches net zero after 2050.

scenarios.label: Intermediate emissions
scenarios.blurb: Emissions stay near today's levels until mid-century, then slowly fall.

scenarios.label: High emissions
scenarios.blurb: Emissions keep rising and roughly double by 2100.

scenarios.label: Very high emissions
scenarios.blurb: Fossil fuel use grows fast; emissions roughly double by 2050.
